description: Kevin Leung, a community leader and education advocate with 35 years in Douglas County, is running for Colorado State Senate District 30. An IT specialist and business owner, he has served on the Douglas County School Board and South Metro Fire Rescue Board. His priorities include affordable housing, strong public schools, and responsible growth. He is also committed to improving the quality of life for seniors. His campaign focuses on collaboration and results.
